Onsite: Boston, MA

 

Who we are looking for

The Execution, Financing & Clearing Portfolio Finance team supports our Agency Lending, Prime Services, Secured Financing and Execution businesses with a focus on portfolio analytics, revenue & resource optimization and market insights. We serve at the intersection of data, reporting and scenario analysis to deliver actionable intelligence that improves decision making.

 

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets (SSM). When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to the SSM business unit. As our investment research and trading arm, SSM’s number one goal is to enhance and preserve our clients’ portfolio values by applying technology, optimizing trading, and linking asset classes and markets across the world. Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

 

What you will be responsible for

Serve as strategic advisor to the Execution business owners, working closely with executive leaders and supporting functions to drive strategy, growth, profitability and market expansion

Develop a deep understanding of business drivers, including revenue, expense & balance sheet attributions

Oversee quarterly and annual financial planning in collaboration with Markets CFO and Investor Relations

Empower Client Management and Trading with portfolio analytics, scenario analysis and optimization tools in collaboration with Portfolio Finance quantitative leads

Create in-depth market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities, trends, and challenges

A dynamic problem solver – consistently utilizes a solution driven mindset

A trusted advisor with the tenacity and business acumen to provide thought leadership and deliver positive commercial outcomes in both the short and long-

Ambitious and driven to deliver business strategy transformation informed by expertise in market and competitor trends

Detail oriented – understands the nuances that can impact overall outcomes

A strong influencer and thoughtful communicator who can express complex ideas in simple, practical terms

Ability to learn quickly, juggle multiple projects, and work autonomously

Entrepreneurial and self-directed – operates as an owner

 

Education & Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of experience in Financial Services or Management Consulting required

Comfortability with modern data management tools (e.g., Databricks)

Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools

Portfolio Management Leadership

Lead the U.S. Systematic Equity portfolio management team, ensuring disciplined execution of investment strategies.

Oversee portfolio construction, implementation, monitoring, and adherence to client guidelines and investment objectives.

Act as the senior escalation point for portfolio management and implementation issues.

Client & Commercial Engagement

Process Improvement & Innovation

Enhance efficiency, scalability, and consistency of the portfolio management operating model across all strategies – active and index.

Drive process improvements, automation, and adoption of advanced tools and analytics.

Partner with Systematic Equity CIO, Head of EMEA & APAC Portfolio Management, Technology, Trading, and Operations to streamline workflows and improve execution, while developing new / improved operating model.

Talent & Organizational Leadership

Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing portfolio management team.

Foster a collaborative, accountable, and performance-driven culture.

Support career development, succession planning, and capability building.

Financial Management

Manage budgets, resourcing, and cost discipline for the portfolio management function.

Support profitability of strategies through operational efficiency and scalable processes.

Align resource allocation with long-term business and growth priorities.

What We Value

Strong systematic/quantitative equity investment expertise

Proven leadership of portfolio management teams

Commercial mindset with client-facing credibility

Deep understanding of portfolio construction, risk, and implementation

Ability to drive operational improvements and scalable processes

Strong judgment in regulated environments

Collaborative, results-oriented leadership style

Education & Experience

15–20+ years in investment management, preferably systematic or quantitative equity

Leadership experience in portfolio management or investment teams

Demonstrated success in client engagement and product development

Solid understanding of U.S. institutional markets

CFA, MBA, or equivalent strongly preferred

title: Director, Program Management
Director, Technical Program Management
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

GitHub is looking for a director to help lead GitHub’s Technical Program Management team in our Engineering organization. You should be an ambitious, passionate, technical, and collaborative leader with a strong background in empowering high performing teams and an ability to deliver results through technical programs. 


The Director, TPM will strengthen TPM's role as a trusted integrator, driving clarity, accountability, and execution across complex, cross-functional initiatives. They will help teams frame problems, align stakeholders, and accelerate decision-making while raising the effectiveness of TPMs and scaling their influence across the company. This director will foster a culture of ownership, bias for action, and operational excellence, ensuring execution remains tightly aligned with strategic priorities. 


Responsibilities

Opportunity and Solutions Identification 

  • Demonstrates and builds experiences across multiple groups or divisions. Leads and coaches teams to develop problem statements and form hypotheses for products and services across divisional boundaries to address highly complex business, program, customer needs, and/or market opportunities; identifies dependencies of other features. 

  • Determines and leads process improvements to quickly scope insights, and drives change management initiatives. Uses industry understanding to direct teams to ensure alignment between the customer, the market, internal stakeholders, senior leadership, and the goals and strategy of GitHub. 

  • Holds teams accountable for collaborating with others (e.g., Engineering, Marketing, Design) to ensure that they can satisfy customer requirements. Provides expertise to help teams validate the market size and opportunity of greatest value for the company. Facilitates collaboration between their team and other partner teams to bring about solutions. 

 

Program Planning and Success 

  • Provides expertise to help teams define the multiple program goals and prioritization for the products and services they own. Guides teams to translate the needs of the organization and other teams into program goals and prioritize deliverables based on data insights.  

  • Guides teams to engage in active risk management (proactive and reactive) to identify risks and propose mitigations for risks using data (e.g., telemetry, usage, net satisfaction, customer satisfaction). 

  • Coaches teams to define success criteria and performance metrics (e.g., Objectives and Key Results [OKRs], Key Performance Indicators [KPIs] such as quality and performance) of products, services and works with engineering to ensure needed telemetry is developed. Provides expert knowledge to help teams deeply understand the return on investment. 

  

Program/Service Development 

  • Acts as a subject matter expert in orchestrating and integrating efforts for the development and implementation process of product, services on large cross functional projects with internal teams and external partners. Drives teams to collaborate and coordinate across teams and perspectives to ensure alignment on product management and release, including tradeoffs, adjustments, and improvements as feasible. 

  • Guides teams to partner with the engineering team to contribute, prioritize, and deliver on the roadmap for product, service. Drives teams to understand the value proposition for the feature(s)/feature areas and answer technical questions on the feature(s)/feature areas they own.  

  • Guides teams to justify capacity requirements and advocate for the right resource allocation. Partners with the Engineering team to know the feature capabilities in alignment with the goal updates and associated tradeoffs. 

  • Guides teams tracking, coordinating, and communicating end-to-end project schedules for products, services. Ensures teams establish and monitor processes, and hold other stakeholders accountable for following the established schedule and processes. 

  • Guides teams when tracking and managing dependencies to enable cohesive, connected user scenarios, and to avoid issues and mitigate risks. Coaches teams to make adjustments or course corrections when projects are not aligned to schedules or goals. 

  • Drives teams to develop the staging and implementation plan for piloting/release in alignment with Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for products, services, its development timeline, and the introduction to the different programs. Ensures teams collaborate with stakeholders to monitor progress and adjust as needed. 

  • Helps teams lead governance programs and processes to ensure that specific performance requirements and standards are met throughout the development lifecycle (e.g., quality, compliance, privacy, security, safety, accessibility). 

 

Continuous Improvement 

  • Provides expertise to help teams partner with others to collect performance metrics (e.g., Key Performance Indicators [KPIs] such as usage, quality, speed, and cost), monitor and report on progress (e.g., business reviews), and derive insights that lead to productive courses of action. 

  • Ensures teams share insights with Engineering and other partners. Leads teams to form hypotheses to technical needs, perform experiments, and iterate to drive improvement in specific performance metrics that have measurable impact. 


Qualifications

Required Qualifications 

  • 8+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 4+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years experience in managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 8+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years people management experience.
  • 4+ years experience designing, building, or supporting software systems. 

Compensation Range

The base salary range for this job is USD $140,400.00 - USD $372,300.00 /Yr.

These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.

This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

EEO Statement

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

title: Vice President, Product & Technology PMO
description:
About Powerfleet
 Powerfleet (Nasdaq: AIOT; JSE: PWR) is a global leader in the artificial intelligence of things (AIoT) software-as-a-service (SaaS) mobile asset industry. With more than 30 years of experience, Powerfleet unifies business operations through the ingestion, harmonization, and integration of data—regardless of source—and delivers actionable insights to help companies meet their strategic objectives around Safety, Compliance, Efficiency and Sustainability. Our people-first culture and relentless innovation empower customers to achieve measurable, sustainable business improvements. Powerfleet serves over 2.6 million subscribers across more than 48,000 customers in 120 countries, with commercial operations across every major continent.

Position Summary

Powerfleet is seeking a Vice President, Product & Technology PMO to lead strategic portfolio management and execution across Product, Engineering, Technology, and enterprise transformation initiatives. This role will establish and drive the operating model, governance, and execution discipline needed to translate Powerfleet’s strategic priorities into measurable business and customer outcomes.

The Vice President, Product & Technology PMO will provide a single, integrated view of major initiatives across the organization, ensuring alignment around priorities, capacity, dependencies, investments, risks, and delivery. Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, and executive leadership, this role will strengthen portfolio decision-making, improve delivery predictability, and create clear accountability for outcomes.

The ideal candidate is a highly experienced technology and transformation leader who combines strong portfolio management expertise with business and financial acumen and thrives in a fast-paced, global environment.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Strategy & Governance

  • Lead the Product & Technology PMO, including program management, project management, scrum, and delivery resources.

  • Establish and maintain portfolio governance across Product, Engineering, Technology, and enterprise transformation initiatives.

  • Develop and manage annual and quarterly planning, prioritization, capacity, and investment processes.

  • Create a single executive view of strategic initiatives, including milestones, dependencies, risks, investments, resource requirements, and expected outcomes.

  • Establish clear governance, decision-making, and accountability frameworks to support effective portfolio execution.

  • Ensure strategic investments remain aligned with organizational priorities and measurable business and customer outcomes.

Program & Delivery Excellence

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders to improve roadmap execution, delivery predictability, and time-to-market.

  • Oversee major technology and enterprise transformation initiatives, ensuring effective planning, execution, and risk management.

  • Drive cross-functional execution across complex programs involving multiple business functions, technologies, geographies, and stakeholders.

  • Identify and proactively address organizational, resource, technology, and delivery dependencies that may impact strategic initiatives.

  • Establish consistent program and portfolio management practices while enabling teams to operate with appropriate flexibility and agility.

  • Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement across portfolio execution.

Executive Reporting & Performance Management

  • Develop executive dashboards and KPIs that provide clear visibility into portfolio health, delivery performance, investment, business value, and customer outcomes.

  • Provide executive leadership with timely, actionable insights into portfolio progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions required.

  • Establish mechanisms to measure value realization and business outcomes associated with strategic technology investments.

  • Improve transparency and consistency in how program performance and portfolio health are communicated across the organization.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Partner with Finance and executive leadership on portfolio investment decisions, resource allocation, capacity planning, and value realization.

  • Develop frameworks to evaluate and prioritize investments based on strategic alignment, expected value, resource requirements, and organizational capacity.

  • Monitor portfolio investments and resource utilization to support informed decision-making and effective allocation of resources.

  • Balance strategic priorities with available capacity to improve organizational focus and execution.

PMO Transformation & Innovation

  • Build and continuously evolve a modern, outcome-driven PMO focused on enabling execution rather than traditional project reporting.

  • Leverage automation, AI-enabled tools, and data-driven insights to improve planning, reporting, forecasting, risk management, and decision-making.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce administrative burden, and increase the speed and quality of portfolio decisions.

  • Establish scalable practices and tools that support Powerfleet’s continued growth and transformation.

Qualifications

  • 15+ years of progressive experience across technology, product, program management, business transformation, and/or enterprise PMO leadership.

  • Significant experience leading global Product and Technology portfolios and complex, enterprise-wide transformation programs.

  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing program management, project management, scrum, and/or delivery teams.

  • Proven ability to partner effectively with C-suite executives and influence decisions across organizational and functional boundaries.

  • Strong understanding of software and product development, enterprise technology, and business transformation.

  • Experience supporting or leading major ERP, CRM, technology rationalization, SaaS, data, AI, and cloud initiatives.

  • Strong knowledge of portfolio management, strategic planning, capacity planning, resource allocation, and investment governance.

  • Demonstrated financial and business acumen, including experience evaluating investments and measuring value realization.

  • Strong executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex portfolio information into clear, actionable insights.

  • Experience implementing modern portfolio management practices, tools, automation, and data-driven reporting.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, global, highly cross-functional environment.

  • Builder mindset with demonstrated success establishing or transforming a PMO into a strategic, outcome-focused function.

Success in the Role

Success in this role will be demonstrated by establishing a transparent and integrated Product & Technology portfolio; improving delivery predictability, prioritization, and capacity management; strengthening visibility into investments, risks, and dependencies; and creating clear accountability for the outcomes of Powerfleet’s most important technology and business transformation initiatives. This leader will help make strategy executable, improve organizational focus, and create greater predictability across execution.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is $230,000- $250,000 USD. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and location.

Powerfleet is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and success, and we’re proud to be a workplace that reflects the communities we serve.

Are you a seasoned delivery leader who knows what it takes to get complex technology programs across the finish line, consistently and at scale? If you're ready to bring people, methodology, and governance together under one clear vision, we've got the opportunity for you!

As our Associate Vice President (AVP) of PMO and Delivery, you'll provide unified executive leadership for our Project Management Office and Delivery Lead departments. You'll partner closely with the SVP of Delivery and own the end-to-end health of NLS project and program delivery, from methodology and staffing to KPIs, budget, and client outcomes.

If you thrive as a trusted advisor, love building high-performing teams, and are ready to shape the future of delivery at a Duck Creek Partner of the Year, we'd love to meet you!

*We know you care about benefits and perks, so feel free to scroll down to that section, and then scroll back up to learn more about this role.

What You'll Do:

  • Own accountability for the performance, quality, and delivery outcomes of the PMO and Delivery Lead departments

  • Directly lead, coach, and evaluate PMO leaders and Delivery Leads through strategic direction, mentorship, and performance management

  • Partner with the SVP of Delivery and other NLS leaders to set and execute annual strategic goals for both departments

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by aligning solutions to business objectives and influencing key decisions

  • Own PMO strategy, including staffing model, resourcing, and methodology standards (Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Waterfall)

  • Ensure the NLS Delivery Assurance Program (iDAP) and NLS Project Playbook are adapted to every implementation type, platform, and SOW structure, and that both are consistently followed

  • Develop, monitor, and report enterprise-level KPIs and delivery metrics, turning trends into action plans

  • Resolve escalated delivery risks and act as the executive escalation point for high-priority, complex engagements

  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and innovation, including the adoption of AI and emerging tools

  • Lead succession planning, talent development, and the 360-degree feedback process for department leadership

  • Partner with sales, account management, and delivery leadership to align resourcing, pipeline, and project outcomes

Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About This Role

Crusoe is scaling one of the fastest-growing global workplace and data center portfolios in the industry, with active real estate initiatives spanning San Francisco, Denver, London, Tel Aviv, Bellevue, and beyond, alongside a rapidly expanding global data center footprint. We're looking for a Senior Director, Real Estate & Portfolio Strategy to lead the strategy, execution, and financial management of our global co-location, manufacturing office and data center lease portfolio.

Reporting directly to the VP, DIG Operations, this role will be a critical partner in aligning our real estate strategy with business growth, headcount planning, employee experience, and long-term financial objectives across both corporate office, co-location, manufacturing and data center real estate. You'll work closely with our exclusive global brokerage partner, Legal, Finance, People, Data Center Operations, and business leaders to deliver thoughtful, data-driven real estate solutions that support Crusoe's continued expansion.

This is an exciting opportunity for a senior real estate leader who thrives on managing multiple concurrent transactions across office, manufacturing and data center/colocation portfolios, enjoys the financial and analytical side of commercial real estate, and wants to build scalable portfolio strategies, lease governance, and audit processes for a rapidly growing global company.

 

What You'll Be Working On

 

• Portfolio Strategy and Asset Management: by partnering with Finance, People, Workplace, and Data Center Operations leadership to translate hiring forecasts, capacity plans, and space/power utilization into real estate recommendations. Evaluate expansion, consolidation, renewal, and exit opportunities across global office and data center markets.

• Lease Portfolio Management: own the master lease abstract database across all locations, tracking key dates, terms, options, renewal windows, and obligations to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

• Lease Review & Abstracting: lead comprehensive lease review and abstracting for new and existing leases, including manufacturing office, data center, and cloud colocation agreements — abstracting key business, financial, and legal terms into standardized formats for portfolio-wide tracking and reporting.

• Transaction Execution: manage end-to-end real estate transactions — including new office and manufacturing leases, renewals, subleases, expansions, contractions, and terminations — in close partnership with our brokers and legal counsel.

• Cloud Colocation & Data Center Lease Management: lead ongoing lease management for cloud colocation and data center leases, including power/capacity commitments, service level agreements, interconnection terms, expansion rights, and hyperscaler lease administration.

• Critical Date Management: own the tracking and management of all critical lease dates across the portfolio — including notice periods, renewal and termination options, rent escalations, expansion/contraction windows, and compliance deadlines — ensuring proactive action ahead of key milestones.

• Financial Analysis & Reporting: build and maintain cash flow models, occupancy cost analyses, rent schedules, lease comparisons, escalations, and CAM reconciliations to support executive decision-making across office, manufacturing and data center portfolios.

• Executive Reporting: prepare business cases, portfolio updates, and executive presentations that translate complex lease and financial data into clear, actionable recommendations for executive leadership.

• Stakeholder Coordination: serve as the primary point of contact between Workplace, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Data Center Operations, and site leadership on all lease-related matters, including purchase order and approval workflows in Coupa.

• Broker & Transaction Management: serve as the relationship manager for Crusoe's global brokerage partner, leading lease negotiations, coordinating transaction strategy, and driving favorable business and financial outcomes across the portfolio.

• Compliance, Risk & Audit Management: track insurance requirements, certificates of occupancy, permits, and critical lease obligations across office and data center locations; manage lease and portfolio audits, proactively identifying and mitigating portfolio risks.

• Site Selection: partner with brokers and internal stakeholders on new market evaluations, including market analysis, site tours, financial comparisons, and lease execution for both office and manufacturing sites.

• Portfolio Systems & Process Improvement: lead the evaluation and implementation of a global lease administration platform while continuously improving portfolio reporting, documentation, and governance — including audit readiness — to support Crusoe's continued growth.

 

What You'll Bring to the Team

• Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Business, Finance, or a related field.

• 15+ years of experience in corporate real estate, portfolio strategy, lease administration, or commercial real estate transaction management, including experience with data center or cloud colocation leasing.

• Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent lease transactions across multiple geographies and asset types, including office and data center/colocation.

• Strong financial acumen, including developing business cases, cash flow projections, occupancy cost analyses, lease economics, and executive recommendations.

• Hands-on experience with lease review, abstracting, and management, including tracking of critical dates, options, and obligations across a large, complex portfolio.

• Experience negotiating commercial lease terms in partnership with brokers and legal counsel, including colocation and data center-specific terms (power, SLAs, interconnection, expansion rights).

• Experience leading or supporting lease and portfolio audits, with a strong understanding of compliance and risk management practices.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing cross-functional partners and executive leadership without direct authority.

• Experience implementing or administering lease management software is highly desirable.

• Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets with strong financial modeling and analytical skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex real estate and financial information for executive audiences.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving business priorities.

 

Bonus Points

• Experience working directly with a global brokerage firm (e.g., JLL, CBRE, Cushman & Wakefield).

• Experience supporting international real estate transactions and global portfolios.

• Direct experience with hyperscaler or wholesale data center lease structures and negotiations.

GitHub's Pull Request Platform powers one of the most critical developer workflows in the world. Every pull request operation across GitHub.com, the API, and GitHub Enterprise Server depends on the systems this team owns. The team is responsible for pull request state, mergeability, indexing, automation, and platform reliability, serving tens of millions of developers who collaborate, review code, and ship software every day. 

 

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help lead Pull Request Platform through a period of significant technical investment. The team is strengthening production reliability in a complex, high-traffic area, contributing to GitHub's service-extraction efforts, and evolving its infrastructure to meet growing scale requirements. You'll join our Core Productivity organization and directly influence the reliability and performance of one of GitHub's most visible and heavily used features. 

 

As a staff engineer, you'll be a hands-on technical leader who shapes architecture, guides complex initiatives, and helps the team turn ambiguous problems into durable solutions. You'll work across Git operations, databases, search, APIs, and asynchronous workflows while helping define the platform's longer-term technical direction. 

 

This work blends distributed systems experience with pragmatic execution — moving between writing and reviewing code, leading architectural decisions, improving production systems, and building alignment across organizational boundaries. You'll partner closely with Pull Request Experience, Repositories Platform, Git Systems, and other teams across GitHub while mentoring engineers and helping the team grow its technical practices. 


Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, implementation, and evolution of systems that power pull requests at GitHub scale. 

  • Help define and execute the Pull Request Platform technical roadmap, aligning engineering investments with GitHub’s reliability, scalability, and service-extraction priorities. 

  • Solve complex technical challenges spanning Git operations, databases, search and indexing, APIs, and asynchronous workflows. 

  • Design, develop, test, and ship maintainable solutions that operate across multiple GitHub services. 

  • Own and advocate for the health of the team’s production systems, including participating in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident improvements. 

  • Set high standards for operational safety, testing, observability, deployment practices, and production rollouts. 

  • Write architecture briefs and technical proposals, conduct code experiments, and clearly communicate tradeoffs and operational risks. 

  • Partner across engineering teams to define scalable interfaces, reduce system friction, and lead initiatives such as service extraction and platform hardening. 

  • Provide technical leadership through mentorship, pairing, code and design reviews, and guidance that helps other engineers deliver extensible, maintainable systems. 

  • Improve engineering and operational excellence through automation, tooling, and standardization across testing, deployment, and operations. 

 


Qualifications

  • 1+ years’ experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems or platform infrastructure with demanding reliability and performance requirements. 

  • 1+ years’ experience diagnosing and improving the scalability, observability, resilience, and performance of high-traffic production systems.

Overview

GitHub is the developer company and the home of open source. We make it easier for developers to be developers: to work together, to solve challenging problems, and to create the world’s most important technologies. We foster a collaborative community that can come together—as individuals and in teams—to create the future of software and make a difference in the world. 

 

The Technical Program Management (TPM) organization leads the delivery of GitHub's most critical product and business initiatives. TPMs help bring new products and capabilities to market by driving execution across engineering, product, design, go-to-market, and business functions. 


Responsibilities

The Technical Program Manager partners with engineering leaders, product managers, and stakeholders across GitHub to build and execute comprehensive program plans, manage dependencies and risks, and ensure teams deliver high-quality outcomes. TPMs provide clear communication, drive alignment, and help leaders make informed decisions throughout the lifecycle of complex initiatives. 

 

Successful TPMs are technically credible, operationally rigorous, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. They bring together diverse teams, balance competing priorities, and make thoughtful tradeoff recommendations that optimize for overall program success. 

 

This role sits within GitHub's Security Products organization. Programs may span application security, software supply chain security, AI-powered security capabilities, developer platforms, and large-scale product launches that reach GitHub's global customer base. 

 

The TPM is also expected to help scale the TPM practice through process improvements, operational excellence, and the development of reusable tools and frameworks. description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

GitHub is seeking a Staff Developer Advocate to join the GitHub Security Lab. The mission of the Security Lab is to inspire and enable the community to secure the open source software we all depend on. We create a home for security researchers where they can collaborate and share, with the common goal of making security easy for developers.


In this role, you will act as a known subject matter expert and trusted ambassador who engages with security researchers, open source maintainers, and enterprise developers and encourages them to get the most out of GitHub Security Lab's security tools and resources — including CodeQL, Dependabot, secret scanning, code scanning, Copilot Autofix, AI-powered vulnerability detection, and the GitHub Advisory Database.


You will define the vision and strategy for the Security Lab's developer advocacy program, producing high-quality technical content (blog posts, tutorials, training, videos, CTFs, conference talks), leading community events, and driving social media campaigns. You will grow our community from a dedicated group of security enthusiasts to everyone who cares about software security. You will also help the security community understand and navigate the evolving intersection of AI and security — from securing AI-generated code to leveraging AI for vulnerability discovery.


As a Staff-level advocate, you bring cross-team influence and deep technical expertise across multiple areas. You don't just execute — you set direction, establish frameworks that help others produce great security content, and proactively identify highly impactful unaddressed issues, mobilizing resources to resolve them before they affect the community. You mentor and sponsor others within the team, and you use data and business outcomes to inform decisions and influence stakeholders across GitHub.


Responsibilities

Understanding the Security Community

Acts as a known subject matter expert of the security research and open source developer communities — their common experiences, goals, industry trends, and key developments — by meeting with community members, attending security and developer conferences, and engaging on social media. Possesses expert knowledge of GitHub's security products and services (CodeQL, code scanning, secret scanning, Dependabot, advisory database) and their potential impact on the broader security ecosystem. Strategically seeks out influencers in the security and open source spaces to understand business drivers and community objectives. Anticipates future changes in the application security landscape, including the impact of AI on security research workflows and the emerging challenges of securing AI-generated code.

Building Trusted Relationships

Acts as a trusted and influential ambassador between the security community and GitHub's product, engineering, and marketing teams. Builds and maintains a broad, diverse network across security researchers, open source maintainers, and enterprise security teams. Utilizes deep understanding of community needs to share valuable insights, best practices, and technical know-how, maintaining thought leadership within the security community.

Internal Advocacy and Impact

Collects and seeks out feedback from the security community and stakeholders regarding product usage, user experience, and technical issues. Communicates clearly and effectively to relevant product groups, advocating for and influencing urgent and long-term improvements to GitHub's security features. Proactively builds and manages networks of key stakeholders and leads engagement through established and informal channels to provide feedback on priorities and emerging security scenarios. Incorporates data and key metrics into findings regarding value-add and impact of advocacy initiatives. Ensures the feedback loop between community members, the Security Lab, and the GitHub product team is effective.

Supporting Key Internal Initiatives

Builds and enhances trust with internal teams through networking and engagement regarding security product improvement plans. Acts as a subject matter expert for internal stakeholders on application security and the security researcher community. Regularly engages in retrospective evaluations to inform future work.

Content Development

Defines, creates, and leads the technical content strategy for the Security Lab — blog posts, tutorials, training courses, videos, CTFs, puzzles, and conference talks — covering topics from traditional vulnerability research to AI-assisted security analysis and secure AI development practices. Drives interactions across technical forums, social media, and community channels to promote awareness and provide best practices. Represents the GitHub Security Lab at high-visibility security and developer conferences, hackathons, and meetups. Sets the standard for content quality and measures impact to continuously improve how we communicate with the security community.

Community Impact

Actively seeks out feedback and listens to the needs of the security community, responding with relevant information and upskilling others to make a substantial impact on community growth. Designs the community member journey — from first engagement to active contributor — measuring retention and engagement along the way. Proposes strategic improvements to the community experience. Manages the Security Lab's social media presence and public forums. Applies deep knowledge of GitHub's security products, stakeholders, and strategic objectives to influence and inspire the audience.

Technical Expertise

Possesses deep technical expertise in application security, secure code practices, vulnerability research, AI-assisted code analysis, and static analysis. Constantly seeks out learning and teaching opportunities and engages in conversations with key security researchers and developers to understand current developments and issues. Applies and practices technical expertise via sample code, CodeQL queries, security advisories, and demonstrations. Builds processes and systems to share technical expertise at scale and works within the industry to help inform future security developments. Understands the security implications of AI-generated code and AI-powered development tools, and can communicate best practices for secure AI adoption to both security researchers and developers. Gains broader knowledge of adjacent technologies and incorporates them into current areas of expertise.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years experience in community/audience engagement, information technology, software development, or related work
    • OR Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in community/audience engagement, information technology, software development, or related work
    • OR equivalent experience
  • Delivered at least one technical keynote on a security topic at a developer conference with 1,000+ attendees
    • OR delivered a session at a major security conference (Black Hat, DEF CON, etc)

  • At least one public contribution (content, open source tooling) on AI/ML security topics — such as securing AI-generated code, AI-assisted vulnerability discovery, or red-teaming LLM-based tools

title: Director of CX Strategy and Portfolio Management
description:
About the Role

As our organization scales, we are fundamentally transforming how we deliver value to our customers. Introducing our advanced robots into dynamic, unstructured environments requires a seamless, enterprise-grade support ecosystem.

Reporting directly to the VP of Customer Experience, the Director of CX Strategy and Portfolio Management will pioneer our shift to treating Customer Experience (CX) as a formalized product. In this role, you will own the strategic roadmap and manage a complex portfolio of initiatives designed to mature the entire CX lifecycle from onboarding and deployment through service, and support. Crucially, this is an inherently non-siloed, connective function; success demands radical, deep-seated collaboration across every single pillar of the business—integrating CX, Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering into one unified, high-velocity engine.

Key Responsibilities

CX Vision and Strategy

This leader will be responsible for four pillars of creating the world's best Customer Experience engine for the world's most advanced unstructured robotic solutions:

Pillar I: CX Product Innovation & Customer Obsession

Product Leadership: Directly manage one Product Manager to productize the end-to-end customer journey with the same rigor as hardware development.

Zero-Friction Mandate: Drive the strategy for "zero friction" scores by translating customer obsession into actionable product requirements and seamless onboarding experiences.

Pillar II: Portfolio & Technical Program Delivery

TPM Management: Lead and mentor a team of three Technical Program Managers (TPMs) to oversee the execution of the CX strategic roadmap.

Serviceability & Scale: Focus the TPM team on maturing legacy systems, improving serviceability, and deploying introspective tooling that enables the CX organization to scale globally.

Pillar III: Strategic CX Integration & Alignment

Executive Partnership: Serve as the primary strategic partner to the VP of Customer Experience, translating high-level vision into actionable, enterprise-wide strategy.

Cross-Functional Synergy: Drive organizational alignment across departmental silos, managing stakeholder relationships to ensure unified outcomes across the entire CX lifecycle.

Pillar IV: Rapid Prototyping & AI/Enterprise Tooling

Dev Team Leadership: Manage a small, dedicated scrum team of developers to rapidly prototype internal tools and advanced CX capabilities.

Tooling Ownership: Own the incubation and iteration of AI initiatives and enterprise tools (e.g., Salesforce) through to the point of handover to the BizOps team.

BizOps Collaboration: Partner closely with BizOps Data Science and BizOps PMO teams to ensure technical prototypes are scalable and data-driven before full enterprise integration.

Qualifications & Key Attributes

Experience: 15+ years of leadership experience in Product Management, Portfolio/Program Management, or CS Strategy, ideally within a scaling B2B technology, hardware, or robotics company.

Methodology Mastery: Deep fluency in product management methodologies (Agile, journey mapping, discovery frameworks) and portfolio management best practices (governance, resource leveling, strategic road mapping).

Systems Architecture & Scaling: A proven track record of taking immature operational processes and scaling them into robust, enterprise-grade systems capable of supporting complex, global deployments.

Change Management Expertise: Demonstrated experience leading large-scale organizational change (e.g., ADKAR or similar frameworks). Excellence in bringing disparate stakeholders together and leading through influence without direct authority.

Customer Obsession & Analytics: A relentless drive to advocate for the user, coupled with the analytical acumen to translate qualitative feedback and quantitative metrics into actionable product requirements.

Exceptional Communication: The ability to seamlessly translate complex operational realities between deep technical engineering teams and customer-facing service personnel.

We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position.

The base pay range for this position is between $195,000 to $255,000 annually. Base pay will depend on multiple individualized factors including, but not limited to internal equity, job related knowledge, skills and experience.  This range represents a good faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Boston Dynamics offers a generous Benefits package including medical, dental vision, 401(k), paid time off and an annual bonus structure.  Additional details regarding these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer for employment.

title: Director, Technical Program Management, Manufacturing and Industrial Engineering
description:
The Modular Manufacturing & Integration organization is leading an industry-defining transformation in how Google delivers technical infrastructure for the AI era. Transitioning away from conventional, on-site, purpose-built construction, our mission is to industrialize data center delivery through mass-assembled, standardized modules and off-site manufacturing.

By pushing labor-intensive assembly, systems integration, and quality testing upstream into controlled factory environments, we enable "square wave" capacity delivery—turning on gigawatt-scale AI compute, liquid cooling, power distribution, and network fabric with unprecedented velocity. Operating across AI Systems & Infrastructure (AI2), Google Data Centers (GDC), Systems & Manufacturing (ISM), and Google Global Infrastructure (GGI), our team defines the modular technical product and serves as the accountable business owner for industrializing and landing modular capacity globally.

As the Principal TPM of Manufacturing & Industrial Engineering, you will be the chief industrial architect responsible for translating Google’s modular infrastructure strategy into an executable, manufacturing reality. In this principal technical leadership role—with the charter to incubate the discipline and potentially scale a dedicated team over time—you will bridge the gap between design engineering, external contract manufacturing, and on-site field execution.

Your remit spans the entire physical and technical stack: structural modules, medium-to-low voltage power skids, liquid cooling distribution, and dense AI compute hardware. You will evaluate current field deployment and operations bottlenecks and establish scalable manufacturing processes with global contract manufacturers and fabricators. Your core mandate is simple yet radical: dramatically compress the timeline from factory gate to live AI compute, reduce complexity of assembly in manufacturing and in the field, and increase first pass yield/quality of the entire data center system.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. title: Director, AI Systems – Scale-up, Scale-out and Networking
description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.

 

AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.




THE ROLE

We are seeking a seasoned technical leader to drive platform readiness and enablement for AMD's next-generation AI infrastructure and connectivity technologies. This Director-level role is responsible for shaping the strategy, execution, and cross-functional alignment required to bring industry-leading scale-up and scale-out solutions to market, with a focus on UA Link, PCI Express (PCIe), CXL, Ethernet, and high-performance AI/HPC systems.

 

Working across silicon, firmware, software, platform engineering, validation, and ecosystem partners, you will lead the development and qualification of technologies that enable large-scale AI racks, accelerator clusters, and next-generation data center platforms. You will play a critical role in ensuring AMD delivers robust, scalable, and innovative connectivity solutions for CPUs, GPUs, accelerators, and AI infrastructure.

 

THE PERSON

You are an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in high-performance computing, AI infrastructure, and data center system architectures. You will lead a global cross functional engineering organization while fostering technical excellence, innovation, and strategic execution across AMD's AI infrastructure portfolio. You combine strong technical judgment with proven organizational leadership, enabling you to influence technical direction, align diverse engineering teams, and successfully execute complex product initiatives.

You thrive in highly collaborative environments, excel at building relationships across organizations, and have a demonstrated ability to scale impact through both technical leadership and people leadership.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Define and drive AMD's strategy for platform readiness, qualification, and ecosystem enablement of next-generation connectivity technologies including UA Link, PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, and future scale-up and scale-out architectures.
  • Lead cross-functional engineering initiatives spanning silicon design, architecture, firmware, software, systems, validation, and product organizations to ensure successful product execution and market readiness.
  • Provide technical and organizational leadership across multiple teams, guiding key architectural decisions, risk management, execution priorities, and long-term technology investments.
  • Partner with internal engineering teams, industry consortiums, strategic customers, and ecosystem partners to accelerate adoption of AMD connectivity solutions and AI infrastructure platforms.
  • Establish scalable validation and qualification strategies, ensuring readiness from pre-silicon development through system bring-up, production qualification, and customer deployment.
  • Represent AMD in executive reviews, cross-functional technical forums, and strategic planning discussions, serving as a trusted technical leader for AI infrastructure and connectivity technologies.

 

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Extensive experience leading server, data center, AI, or HPC platform architecture, systems engineering, validation, or product development organizations.
  • Deep understanding of modern connectivity and interconnect technologies including UA Link, PCIe Gen5/Gen6, CXL, Ethernet, high-speed SerDes, coherent fabrics, and large-scale distributed computing systems.
  • Proven track record delivering complex products from architecture definition through silicon development, platform bring-up, qualification, customer enablement, and production launch.
  • Experience collaborating across architecture, design, validation, firmware, software, manufacturing, and customer-facing organizations while influencing technical direction across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success building, mentoring, and leading high-performing engineering teams, with the ability to drive execution through both direct leadership and organizational influence.

 

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.

Master's degree, PhD, or equivalent industry experience preferred.

 

LOCATION:

San Jose, CA

 

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

title: Director, Portfolio, Resourcing and Transformation
description:
About the role

At AstraZeneca, we’re not afraid to do things differently. We’re building a new kind of organization to reset expectations of what a bio-pharmaceutical company can be. This means we’re opening up new ways to work, pioneering ground-breaking methods and bringing cross-functional teams together.

Biologics Engineering (BE) and Oncology Targeted Discovery (OTD) are pivotal organizations of over 1,000 people building the AstraZeneca portfolio across Biopharmaceuticals, Oncology and Infectious Diseases. With our ambition of delivering 20 new medicines by 2030, we must decide clearly where to invest our scientific capacity, bring AI into how we discover and develop medicines, and build next-generation talent.

This role sits where science, portfolio and transformation meet. You will shape how our scientific capacity is allocated across therapy areas, and how we decide what to start, continue, slow or stop. And you will lead strategic and transformation projects, including bringing AI into how we work, with direct exposure to senior scientific and functional leadership.

The ideal candidate combines analytical difficulty with the standing to align senior leaders who do not report to them. They are as comfortable facilitating a decision between Vice Presidents as they are building the numbers that make that decision possible, and they hold both to the same standard.

You will be responsible for

1. Portolio resource allocation and decision-making.

Run the resource allocation process with leadership teams and therapy area representatives, starting in BE, with scope to extend across the wider organization over time.

Partner with the teams that produce resourcing actuals to improve existing reports, put the numbers in context, and turn them into inputs for decisions, so that allocation is decided rather than left to drift.

Ensure new work starts only where capacity exists or a named release is agreed, and that work is slowed or stopped through scheduled reviews and clear triggers, in partnership with the leaders who own those decisions.

Keep a clear record of allocation decisions and their expected effect on capacity and check the delivered effect against actuals.

Evolve the methodology, rules and forums as needs change and adapt them as new parts of the organization come into scope.

2. Strategic projects and transformation

Lead high-impact strategic projects for the leadership teams of BE and OTD, from framing the question through to recommendation and implementation.

Drive delivery of AI transformation programs: turn ambition into a clear roadmap, and set up the governance, cadence and reporting that keep it on track.

Bring senior leaders across departments behind shared priorities, and resolve interdependencies, resourcing questions and decisions as they arise.

Projects may also include operating model and organizational design choices, evaluating new capabilities and technology platforms, building investment cases, and portfolio and competitive analyses that inform where to focus.

Track delivery and value against agreed objectives, connect initiatives to portfolio and resourcing plans, and bring risks and decisions to sponsors early.

Assemble and lead cross-functional project teams and develop the people in them.

Build outcomes into ongoing ways of working and help what works spread across the wider organization.

3. Leadership and organizational effectiveness

Shape the governance cadence of the leadership teams you support agendas, pre-reads, and decisions and actions followed through to completion.

Track and report progress against goals and scorecard critical metrics, and flag risks to delivery early.

Own recurring operating processes end to end, so they run reliably without critical issue, and keep simplifying them.

Prepare executive-ready materials for senior leadership.

Partner with Finance, Portfolio and Capacity Management, HR and Communications to keep portfolio, resourcing and headcount views aligned.

Support internal communications and organizational effectiveness priorities, including engagement and employee feedback, and turn themes into actions.

Essential qualifications and experience

Bachelors Degree required with 10+ years of experience or Masters or MBA with 8+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry, consulting or a comparable R&D environment, including portfolio, strategy or transformation roles.

A track record of running resource allocation, portfolio prioritization or capacity planning processes that senior leaders relied on to make decisions.

Has led to strategic projects from problem framing to implementation, working directly with senior collaborators.

Has led a cross-functional transformation program and aligned senior leaders without direct authority.

Confident with capacity and financial data, with close attention to detail on forecasts, budgets and variances.

Turns complex information into clear recommendations and presents them with confidence to senior leadership.

Builds trust: an active listener with cultural sensitivity, discretion with confidential information, and a commitment to AstraZeneca’s values.

Works well with ambiguity and pace, acts without complete information, and adapts as priorities change.

Desirable

Understanding of drug discovery and development

Experience of AI, digital or data programs in an R&D setting

A background in strategy or management consulting roles

The annual base pay for this position ranges from $159,180.80 - $238,771.20. Our positions offer eligibility for various incentives—an opportunity to receive short-term incentive bonuses, equity-based awards for salaried roles and commissions for sales roles. Benefits offered include qualified retirement programs, paid time off (i.e., vacation, holiday, and leaves), as well as health, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility.

description:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Staff Technical Program Manager to lead and coordinate cross-functional teams in the development of advanced vehicle subsystems. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the successful execution of complex technical, new architecture programs relating to development and integration of vehicle controls systems and SW.

This is a high-impact role that requires a deep technical understanding of the vehicle architecture, component interfaces, dependencies as well as exceptional program management skills with a strong ability to manage ambiguity. As a key member of our engineering team, you will work closely with HW and SW leads, test asset build teams, electrical engineering architects, validation teams, and other stakeholders to ensure timely execution, manage risks, dependencies, and critical deliverables.

Responsibilities

  • Program Leadership: Lead end-to-end technical programs to deliver vertically integrated hardware and software for vehicle controls subsystems for multiple EV platforms, with special focus on early/new generation architecture. Ensure alignment with company objectives and technical milestones.

  • Systems Engineering & Scoping: Collaborate with technical teams to scope integration requirements using systems engineering principles. Identify test asset needs and coordinate test plans (subsystem and vehicle level) based on software and hardware deliverables, as well as Component, Vehicle DVP timing.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Electrical/Mechanical Hardware, Software Development, and Validation teams to ensure smooth software-hardware integration, validation, calibration throughout the program lifecycle.

  • Prioritization & Planning: Develop and manage detailed subsystem integration timelines and resource allocation for integration efforts, accounting for dependencies and timing of supplier deliverables. Prioritize components for test asset development based on technical risk, program milestones, and system complexity.

  • Technical Risk Management: Drive the identification and resolution of technical issues throughout the software and hardware integration process. Manage risks and dependencies to minimize delays.

  • Integration Testing: Coordinate the development and execution of verification test plans. Promote automated scalable validation principles, ensuring testing aligns with program milestones and quality standards.

  • Stakeholder Communication: Provide regular program updates to leadership and the development teams to ensure all teams are working towards the same goal. Conduct healthy escalations to ensure deliverables are met and mitigate potential risks before they impact the timeline.

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve program management processes, integration workflows, and test processes. Implement best practices to optimize efficiency and quality.

Qualifications

  • Education: BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related technical field. Advanced degrees preferred.

  • Experience:

    • 5+ years of relevant experience in technical program management, with at least 3 years focused on integration and development of powertrain, body, thermal, energy systems HW and SW in the automotive/EV sector.

    • Proven expertise in managing complex programs that involve both hardware and software integration, especially in an automotive or high-tech environment.

    • 3+ years of experience with Systems Engineering principles and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

    • Experience with test and validation strategies, particularly related to integration testing and verification for automotive or EV systems.

  • Technical Expertise:

    • In-depth knowledge of different vehicle architectures and components required for the subsystem, homologation impacts, embedded systems, and real-time control software.

    • Hands-on experience with hardware/software bring-up (using ECUs, sub-components, and vehicle systems), integration, and validation of distributed systems.

    • Experience working with tools like Python, C/C++, MATLAB/Simulink, CarSim, and other simulation or modeling tools is a plus.

  • Program Management Skills:

    • Expertise in managing software development projects using Agile and Waterfall methodologies. Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, and other program management tools.

    • Strong organizational, communication, and collaboration skills. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage complex project dependencies.

    • Proven track record of successfully managing project risks, dependencies, and deliverables to ensure timely and high-quality results.

Total Rewards

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs.

External candidates can apply for this role through the Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site (https://rivianvw.tech/#careers). If you are a current employee, please apply through our internal job board.

Equal Opportunity

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are also committed to ensuring compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws regarding citizenship and immigration status.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com.

Candidate Data Privacy

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies” may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) record keeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our People Team, Finance, Legal, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies affiliates; and (iii) Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies’ service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions.

If you provide a mobile telephone number as part of your application or during the recruitment process, Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may use that number to contact you via SMS text message for recruitment-related purposes, including scheduling, logistics, and status updates. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out of SMS communications at any time by replying STOP to any text message you receive from us. Consent to receive SMS messages is not a condition of applying for or being considered for employment.

Please see our Candidate Data Privacy Notice (English) and Candidate Data Privacy Notice (Serbian) for more information.

--

Please note this job posting represents an open, active vacancy. Additionally, we are not currently accepting applications from third party application services.

Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

 

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

 

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

Staff Tech Portfolio Manager, Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS)

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and execution-focused Staff Tech Portfolio Manager to lead enterprise Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) programs that improve developer productivity, platform reliability, operational readiness, and business delivery. This role partners across Engineering, Architecture, Product, Security, Risk, Finance, Operations, and application teams to translate platform strategy into actionable roadmaps, measurable outcomes, and scalable execution.

Key Responsibilities

Lead cross-functional planning, prioritization, sequencing, and delivery for high-impact PaaS platform programs, ensuring alignment across platform services, consuming application teams, and enterprise priorities.

Define and manage platform roadmaps, dependencies, risks, milestones, adoption plans, governance checkpoints, and executive-level status reporting.

Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Security, Risk, Operations, and Finance to ensure platform investments support scalability, reuse, compliance, resiliency, cost efficiency, and measurable business value.

Establish and track platform KPIs, including adoption, reliability, developer experience, time-to-market, operational health, supportability, and cost efficiency.

Drive delivery excellence through agile, iterative, and outcome-oriented practices, ensuring programs are supported by clear documentation, adoption playbooks, readiness plans, and post-launch learning.

Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders by translating technical priorities, delivery tradeoffs, platform risks, and investment decisions into clear business outcomes.

Promote consistent platform consumption, standards, best practices, and change readiness across application teams and internal platform stakeholders.

Evaluate emerging platform technologies, automation capabilities, developer tools, and operational practices that improve delivery speed, reliability, and developer experience.

Qualifications

10+ years of experience leading enterprise technology, program management, or platform portfolios with ownership of complex, cross-functional initiatives.

Strong understanding of enterprise platform capabilities, including developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, shared services, APIs, container platforms, integration services, and core enterprise systems.

Demonstrated ability to partner with architecture and engineering leaders while maintaining a customer-, business-, and outcome-oriented perspective.

Proven track record delivering high-impact programs in ambiguous environments while managing dependencies, risks, stakeholders, and measurable outcomes.

Strong influence and communication skills, with the ability to align technical, business, security, compliance, and operations stakeholders.

Experience with agile, lean, and iterative delivery models applied to platform or enterprise-scale initiatives.

Ability to build and present executive-ready roadmaps, dashboards, adoption plans, and impact stories using tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, Jira, Aha!, or similar platforms.

Preferred Experience & Certifications

Experience with PaaS capabilities such as container platforms, messaging, workflow orchestration, API management, file exchange, databases, caching, identity, certificate management, monitoring, and infrastructure automation.

General Familiarity with Infrastructure and Platform services and their purpose like Kubernetes, Azure, AWS, Terraform, CI/CD platforms, observability tooling, and enterprise service management practices.

Preferred certifications include SAFe, PMP, PMI-PgMP, Certified Scrum Professional, cloud platform certifications, or relevant product/program management credentials.
