Role Summary

Are you a highly experienced Technical Program Manager with a proven track record of successfully delivering high-quality software for evolving product platforms in complex, integrated software-hardware environments? We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented individual to take a leading role in managing the software delivery for new vehicle launches. As a critical member of our Software Technical Program Team, you will be instrumental in launching new vehicle variants and ensuring the seamless integration of new features, while upholding the highest standards of software quality.

Responsibilities

  • Define and drive comprehensive plans for software-impacting hardware changes and new software features, for both consumer and commercial vehicles

  • Influence company and program milestones to align with software schedules

  • Drive software-hardware integration efforts, acting as a principal liaison and problem-solver for the most challenging cross-domain dependencies

  • Cultivate strong working relationships across all levels of the organization and foster deep collaboration to ensure seamless software integration and the successful launch of new vehicle variants

  • Take ownership of prioritizing and driving the swift resolution of software issues that arise during development

  • Manage verification test plans tailored to the unique software and hardware configurations of new product variants

  • Deliver clear, concise, and insightful updates on the progress of software delivery to the program team, executive leadership, and key stakeholders

  • Proactively identify and strategically mitigate systemic risks to software delivery timelines or quality, implementing effective mitigation strategies and healthily escalating concerns as needed

  • Initiate, champion, and lead significant continuous process improvements within the software development lifecycle and program management frameworks

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to other Technical Program Managers, fostering best practices and contributing to the growth and development of the program management function

 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field

  • 6+ years of progressive Technical or Engineering Program Management experience, demonstrating a strong and successful track record in software delivery for complex, integrated software-hardware products at scale

  • Proven expertise in spearheading the strategic development and successful production launch of new products, particularly those with intricate interdependencies between software and electrical hardware systems

  • Exceptional communication, collaboration, and influencing skills, with a proven ability to effectively lead, align, and motivate diverse cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders in highly dynamic and ambiguous environments

  • Deep, practical mastery of both Agile and Waterfall development methodologies, with advanced proficiency in Jira and other program management tools to manage complex software delivery, and to define and implement best practices

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience as a software or hardware product development engineer

  • Experience with over-the-air (OTA) software update strategies and deployment for connected devices or systems

  • Experience in the automotive industry

description:
Intuit is the global platform company powering prosperity for over 100 million consumers and businesses across TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, and Mailchimp. Within Intuit's business platform, the Global Business Solutions Group is $11B in annual revenue, and its Services portfolio of Payments, Lending, Bill Pay, and Workforce Solutions represents its biggest priorities and fastest-growing businesses. Across these experiences, we are evolving from workflows our customers run themselves to done-for-you experiences powered by AI, where Intuit helps customers get invoices paid faster, do payroll with less work, and access capital right when it's needed.

 

Each of these businesses is scaling fast. Together, they are an integrated portfolio that helps small businesses run and grow on one platform. Making these services grow together, not just side by side, is one of the biggest opportunities at Intuit, and that's the mandate of this role.

 

As Principal on the Services Portfolio Strategy & Growth team, you will drive clarity on cross-portfolio strategy and growth: where the portfolio should play, how the services win together, and what it takes to accelerate growth across them. Strategy and execution happen in parallel here; you'll build the 3-year view and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to execute.

 

You will operate as a senior individual contributor with Services-wide reach, working directly with Services leadership and partners across the Intuit ecosystem, including Product, Engineering, Commercial, and Finance.


Responsibilities

Shape the portfolio growth strategy

  • Shape the 3-year growth strategy for the Services portfolio: priority customers, competitive landscape, and where the next horizons of growth come from.

  • Develop the frameworks and choices that clarify tradeoffs for senior leadership: where to invest, where to sequence, where to say no.

  • Identify and champion 'better together' plays across services (attach, bundling, cross-sell, and shared customer journeys) that no single business would build alone.

  • Develop the fact base that grounds annual and long-range planning, positioning Services at the company level.

 

Build the fact base that drives decisions

  • Own the analytical foundation for portfolio strategy: how the portfolio grows, what drives it, and where the leverage is.

  • Distill insights from imperfect data into executive-ready narratives.

  • Establish repeatable systems for diagnosing performance and evaluating initiatives, so decisions are data-backed and fast.

 

Turn strategy into action

  • Move from long-term thinking to short-term unblock: identify the highest-leverage growth actions, drive alignment on them, and land outcomes.

  • Lead priority cross-portfolio initiatives from problem definition through results, mobilizing partner teams across the segment.

  • Anticipate where alignment will break down across businesses and proactively drive resolution.

 

Create clarity across a complex portfolio

  • Act as connective tissue across the services businesses, surfacing what each is learning, where they overlap, and where the portfolio is leaving growth on the table.

  • Deliver a clear narrative of portfolio strategy and growth opportunities to Services and Intuit senior leadership.

  • Influence with and without authority: build trust with GMs and functional leaders so the portfolio view shapes their choices.


Qualifications

Experience

  • 10+ years in strategy consulting or strategy & business operations in high-growth environments. Top-tier strategy consulting experience strongly preferred. Fintech, payments, and financial services expertise helpful but not required; you'll come up the curve on the Services businesses quickly, supported by internal experts.

 

Strategic & Analytical Strength

  • Exceptional structured problem-solving: you can take an ambiguous, multi-business question and turn it into a clear set of choices.

  • Deep analytical fluency: comfortable building the model, pressure-testing the data, and standing behind the number in front of executives.

  • Ability to distill complexity into insight and insight into a compelling story.

 

Execution & Ownership

  • Track record of moving a business from strategy to action to results, not just producing the deck.

  • Extreme ownership mindset; comfortable operating with urgency, ambiguity, and evolving priorities.

 

Collaboration & Influence

  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across organizations you don't control.

  • Low ego, high trust: you make the businesses you partner with better, and they want you in the room.

 

Communication

  • Executive-level written and verbal communication; able to simplify complexity and influence at scale.

 

AI Fluency

  • Native user of AI tools to accelerate analysis, synthesis, and communication.

Position Overview

Intuit's Platform Brand Marketing organization is entering an ambitious year, bringing new capabilities to market under the Intuit brand, activating a founding partnership with Team USA and the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games, and evolving how the Intuit brand shows up across campaigns, products, cultural moments, and sponsorships.  

As Principal, Platform Brand Marketing Strategic Operations, you are the operating backbone behind that portfolio. You shape how the organization operates and carries its story to leadership. You build and establish the rhythms, frameworks, and reporting that connect priorities, plans, investment, and performance so leadership has a clear view of the business and where decisions are needed. You bring fluency in brand and creative, strong operational judgment, and experience navigating a fast-paced, cross-functional SaaS environment.


Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

1.  Operating Rhythm, Scale & Operational Excellence

  • Architect and run the operating system for Platform Brand Marketing — including leadership cadences, performance reviews, QBRs, annual planning, and decision forums — so priorities, investments, and teams stay aligned and leadership attention is focused on the decisions that matter.

  • Own the integrated brand portfolio calendar and use it to shape sequencing across campaigns, activations, and cultural moments — avoiding collisions, identifying opportunities for halo, and protecting the exploration time strong creative work requires.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve how the organization works, and design and implement AI-enabled, scalable solutions that simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, strengthen reporting, and accelerate decision-making.

  • Drive the 3-year and 1-year Platform Brand planning cycles, translating brand and campaign priorities into a sequenced portfolio of initiatives with clear owners, milestones, success measures, investment requirements, and accountability.

2.  Executive Reporting & Communications

  • Build the recurring Platform Brand Marketing executive reporting — pull together the data, find the story, and deliver clear communications that answer: How are we performing? Where are we headed? Where do we need a decision, and why does it matter?

  • Get ahead of the questions before they’re asked - anticipate what the executive team will need to align, decide, and act, and bring forward the data, recommendations, and clear action plans that keep the team moving quickly.

  • Build high-trust relationships across Finance, Sales, Product Marketing, Media, Comms, and other partners, acting as the connective tissue that keeps brand priorities, investments, and execution aligned.

4.  Investment, Budget and Performance Visibility

  • Establish consistent processes to evaluate how Platform Brand Marketing invests - recommending where to shift spend, when to double down, and what to cut based on what is driving results. 

  • Drive the annual and in-year budget process end-to-end: build the investment case, defend allocation in company-wide planning, and manage forecast cycles as priorities evolve

  • Leverage AI tools to build real-time budgeting dashboards and automate reporting, freeing up capacity for higher-order analysis and strategy in partnership with the finance team.


Qualifications

Qualifications

Required

  • Brand fluency: You understand how full-funnel campaigns and activations are built, measured, and funded, and can use that fluency to challenge sequencing and identify portfolio opportunities. You are comfortable reading and using brand health and campaign performance data.

  • Financial fluency: comfortable with forecasts, accruals, plan-to-budget reconciliation, and translating investment data into a clear executive narrative. You have owned the operating and reporting layer for a portfolio at scale; a Finance background is not required.

  • Exceptional executive communication: able to compress messy, incomplete inputs into a short, factual point of view, a clear recommendation, and communications written credibly in a leader's voice.

  • Builder from ambiguity: takes problems that arrive unformed; shifting priorities, funding that moves underneath a plan, or a question no one has structured yet, and comes back with a framework, first draft, or recommendation rather than a request for direction. You can point to operating mechanisms you built from zero, explain the choices you made, and show how they changed the way a team worked.

  • Influence through operating discipline: builds mechanisms where accountability is structural; cadences, decision forums, and sources of truth people trust and use, and drives adoption without direct authority over the teams involved.

  • AI fluency: You actively use AI in your work today; for analysis, synthesis, reporting, automation, or drafting and look for practical ways to eliminate repetitive work.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

Preferred

  • Prior experience building or scaling a marketing COE or operating model from the ground up

description:
Chief Portfolio Engineer (Principal)

Company:
The Boeing Company

The Boeing Intelligence Systems Maverick portfolio is seeking a Chief Portfolio Engineer (Principal) to join our team in Herndon, VA.

 

This role plays a critical leadership role across multiple Intelligence Systems programs assuring quality engineering in design, build, delivery, issue and risk management of mission critical systems. This chief engineering position sets the vision and implements the strategies for sound engineering practices and processes for all portfolio programs. Intelligence Systems is a portfolio of classified programs within Boeing Space, Intelligence & Weapon Systems. 

 

The chief portfolio engineer will ensure all technical aspects of each program are executed properly including product definition, validation, software and systems engineering, design integration, test and evaluation, and certification for the Boeing team and all associated supplier work content.  The portfolio Chief Engineer will also develop multi-disciplined skills, model-based tools, and standardized processes to deliver engineering for mission products through the lifecycle of the programs.  The program chief engineers will also be direct reports to the Intelligence Systems Chief Engineer.

 

Position Responsibilities:

Provides the Engineering leadership to a team representing multiple skill areas, which may include internal and external resources and customers

Develops statement of work (SOW) to satisfy research and development, ongoing and new business requirements

Collaborates with program engineers and business development to identify new and follow on concepts that will expand product or services lines. Anticipates change and organizes processes and resources to proactively respond

Identifies performance metrics and ensures that work and project breakdown structure (WBS/PBS), schedule and resource loading is completed by the team.

Develops and communicates responsibility authority accountability (RAA) to define team members' roles and responsibilities

Collaborate with cross-functional teams (software, hardware, verification, test, integration, product management) to ensure architectural coherence and timely delivery

Incorporates lessons learned into strategic process improvements. Prepares and presents outcomes, assessments and corrective action initiatives to Boeing management

Create and maintain interface control documents (ICDs)

Develop and maintain system architecture artifacts that align with program objectives and stakeholder needs

Elicit, write, analyze, and manage system-level requirements throughout the development lifecycle

Produce and maintain Concept of Operations (ConOps) documents capturing operational scenarios, use cases, and stakeholder roles

 

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):

Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology (including Manufacturing Technology), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement

This position requires an active TS/SCI clearance with a current and active Full Scope polygraph

9 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience

7+ years of experience with software development and/or Information Systems architecture design and operations

Knowledge of and ability to lead key engineering boards and review processes.

Experience with design trade studies, risk assessments, and technical decision-making; capturing rationale and outcomes

Experience with Requirements Management best practices and traceability

Experience with system integrated testing and Verification / Validation processes

 

 Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):

Experience leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams

Strong Communication, Adaptability, Decision Making, Customer Focus, Integrated Systems, Engineering Analysis, and Requirements/Tracing skillset

Experience designing and delivering Information Technology systems or products

Experience in agile/sprint planning, reviews, and continuous improvement activities to support rapid development cadence

 

Conflict of Interest:

Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company’s Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process

 

Drug Free Workplace:

Boeing is a Drug Free Workplace where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria is met as outlined in our policies.

 

Pay & Benefits:

At Boeing, we strive to deliver a Total Rewards package that will attract, engage and retain the top talent.  Elements of the Total Rewards package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. 

 

The Boeing Company also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. 

 

The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.  

 

Summary pay range for Principal (Level 6): $210,800.00 - $285,200.00

Export Control Requirement:
This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.

Safety Sensitive:

This position requires an active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) U.S. Security Clearance with an adjudicated Counterintelligence or Full Scope Polygraph (U.S. Citizenship Required). (A U.S. Security Clearance that has been active in the past 24 months is considered active.).

description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As an Executive Assistant at Mistral, you will support two senior leaders: our VP, Cloud and our VP, Product. These are distinct teams with their own leadership, stakeholders, and priorities. You will be the operational backbone for both, with stakeholders spanning engineering, product, go-to-market, customers, partners, and investors across France, Europe, and the US.

The role has been created because both organizations are scaling fast and their leaders' time is the scarcest resource. You will own the leaders' calendars, communications, travel, and meeting preparation end to end and go further: coordinating cross-functional initiatives, running leadership rituals, and supporting high-stakes external moments such as customer and partner engagements, roadshows, and board or investor touchpoints.

Balancing two executives from different teams takes real judgment: you will arbitrate scheduling conflicts, keep both leaders ahead of commitments, and handle sensitive information with discretion, representing them with professionalism in every interaction. This is a role with real ownership where you will design the processes, dashboards, and ways of working that keep two distinct organizations running smoothly.

What You Will Do

  • Run the VP, Cloud's and VP, Product's calendars and priorities across multiple time zones, arbitrating between competing demands to protect their focus for strategic decisions.

  • Prepare briefings, agendas, presentations, and follow-up notes for leadership, board, investor, customer, and partner meetings.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders on behalf of both leaders, handling email, Slack, and calls with clarity, judgment, and confidentiality.

  • Coordinate international and domestic travel for both executives, including itineraries for customer roadshows and executive offsites across Europe and the US.

  • Organize internal and external events end to end including team gatherings, client meetings, offsites, and company-wide moments.

  • Drive cross-functional projects and initiatives that connect the Cloud and Product organizations with GTM, Engineering, Datacenter, and People & Operations, from planning through follow-through.

  • Build and maintain both orgs' operational backbone including documentation, dashboards, shared folders, and tracking of deadlines and deliverables.

  • Spot inefficiencies and own process improvements or special projects that raise the bar for how both organizations operate.

Skills We're Looking for

  • Proven experience supporting senior executives (VP level or above) as an Executive Assistant, ideally multiple leaders simultaneously, in tech, infrastructure, or other complex high-growth environments.

  • Exceptional communication skills in English and fluency in French is essential.

  • Demonstrated judgment in balancing competing priorities across multiple leaders, teams, and time zones with discretion and confidentiality.

  • Strong command of Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, plus productivity tools such as Notion and Slack.

  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset - you anticipate needs, close loops, and take ownership of outcomes without being asked.

  • A genuine interest in AI and technical products. You learn quickly and engage credibly with engineers, product managers, customers, and executives.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: ETF Portfolio Analytics Director, Vice President, State Street Investment Management
description:
Who we are looking for

 

The ETF Portfolio Analytics Director, Vice President, is part of the Global ETF Research team. The role is responsible for developing and delivering customized portfolio analytics that help clients understand how portfolios are constructed, where vulnerabilities may be present, and how different investment solutions can support specific portfolio objectives.

 

The position combines portfolio diagnostics, asset allocation research, analytical tool development, and client-specific investment analysis. It covers both proprietary and non-proprietary funds and evaluates products according to the role they may play within a broader portfolio.

The role has a specific focus on:

·         Customized portfolio analytics and portfolio construction insights,

·         Strategic and tactical asset allocation analysis across asset classes, regions, factors, and investment styles,

·         Assessment of portfolio vulnerabilities, including concentration, unintended exposures, diversification gaps, drawdown sensitivity, liquidity considerations, and other sources of risk,

·         Evaluation of how proprietary and non-proprietary funds may serve different portfolio roles, such as core exposure, diversification, risk mitigation, income, liquidity management, or targeted return enhancement,

·         Development and maintenance of scalable analytical tools, methodologies, and client-ready portfolio diagnostics,

·         Leadership, quality oversight, and development of junior team members.

 

As an ETF Portfolio Analytics Director, you will work closely with ETF specialists, investment strategists, sales teams, and other stakeholders across the State Street Investment Management organization. You will translate complex portfolio findings into clear, commercially relevant insights and collaborate with marketing, product, and investment teams to support client engagement and business priorities.

The successful candidate will combine strong investment judgment with quantitative and communication skills. They will be able to move from portfolio-level diagnosis to practical asset allocation considerations, explain the interaction between holdings and exposures, and identify how individual funds can contribute to a coherent portfolio solution.

 

Why this role is important to us

 

The team you will join is part of State Street Investment Management, one of the world's largest asset managers, serving governments, institutions, and financial advisors globally. With more than four decades of experience and trillions of dollars in assets under management, we offer a broad range of investment solutions across asset classes, risk profiles, regions, and investment styles. As pioneers in index investing and ETFs, we continue to develop new ways to help investors build portfolios.

Clients increasingly need analysis that goes beyond selecting an individual fund. They need to understand how exposures interact at the portfolio level, whether diversification is effective, where risk may be concentrated, and which implementation choices are most appropriate for their objectives and constraints. High-quality portfolio analytics can turn fund-level data into actionable portfolio construction insights and is an important capability supporting the growth of our ETF business.

Join us if you are ready to make an immediate impact by helping clients identify portfolio vulnerabilities, evaluate asset allocation choices, and use investment products more effectively within complete portfolios.

What you will be responsible for

 

Customized portfolio analytics and portfolio diagnostics:

·         Lead the design and delivery of customized analyses for client portfolios, model portfolios, and strategic sales opportunities,

·         Assess portfolio structure across asset classes, regions, sectors, factors, currencies, investment styles, and underlying holdings,

·         Identify potential vulnerabilities, including concentration risk, overlapping exposures, unintended factor tilts, diversification gaps, drawdown sensitivity, liquidity constraints, and dependence on individual market outcomes,

·         Apply scenario analysis, stress testing, risk decomposition, performance attribution, correlation analysis, and other relevant methods to explain portfolio behavior,

·         Translate analytical findings into clear observations, trade-offs, and implementation considerations for clients and internal stakeholders,

·         Produce the Portfolio Insights and Analysis output, providing an in-depth assessment of portfolio construction, areas of weakness, potential risk, and opportunities to improve portfolio resilience.

 

Asset allocation and portfolio construction strategies:

·         Evaluate strategic and tactical asset allocation approaches in the context of client objectives, investment horizons, risk tolerances, liquidity needs, and implementation constraints,

·         Analyze how changes in asset allocation may affect portfolio risk, return drivers, diversification, and sensitivity to market scenarios,

·         Develop analytical frameworks that connect macroeconomic and market views with portfolio exposures and possible implementation choices,

·         Assess the role of different building blocks within a total portfolio, including core beta, active, factor, fixed income, liquidity, income, alternatives, and risk-management exposures,

Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on portfolio strategy, investment priorities, risks, and tradeoffs.

Ensure effective risk management, governance, financial stewardship, and delivery

Deep understanding of portfolio, program, project, Agile, and product delivery methodologies.

title: Director, SMB and Platform Risk
description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About the Role

As Director, SMB and Platforms Risk, you will own the first-line risk strategy and operating model for our SMB and platform sellers globally. You'll be based in London and report to the VP, Risk Operations. You will lead onboarding and monitoring teams in Mauritius and Mexico through local team leaders, and a BPO partner.

You will partner with Product, Risk Analytics, Engineering and Commercial to make onboarding and monitoring scalable, measurable and proportionate to risk. We're looking for a programmatic, systems-minded risk leader who can design the operating model and run it day to day, protecting the business while enabling responsible growth.

What You'll Do

  • Set the risk strategy and operating model across the seller lifecycle: onboarding, risk-based tiering, review criteria, monitoring triggers and actions such as reserves, funds controls and termination.

  • Partner with Product, Risk Analytics and Engineering to turn risk needs into clear requirements, decision logic and a prioritised automation roadmap.

  • Define and track the KPIs that balance control, customer experience and cost, including straight-through processing, onboarding time, loss rates and alert precision.

  • Lead operational performance across teams in Mauritius and Mexico through local leaders, setting priorities, procedures, SLAs, quality standards and capacity plans.

  • Scale the operation as headcount grows: stand up additional teams as needed, govern BPO partners, and prioritise automation improvements.

  • Close the loop between cases, losses and fraud patterns so that rules, thresholds, policy and product priorities keep improving.

  • Own first-line control quality and audit readiness, with clear handoffs of risks, issues and remediation to second-line oversight.

  • Represent SMB and Platforms Risk in governance, product and commercial forums, including risk-based pricing and bespoke platform deals. Hold a clear risk position while finding structured paths to yes.

  • Apply AI and LLM-enabled tools to triage, case summarisation, QA and risk insight, with appropriate human review, data protection and audit trails.

What We're Looking For

  • Deep risk expertise in SMB acquiring, with a strong grasp of credit exposure, reserves, fraud and transaction monitoring across the seller lifecycle.

  • Understanding of platform and PayFac models, including ISVs, marketplaces and merchant-of-record structures.

  • Working knowledge of KYC/KYB and CDD, and of how onboarding controls connect to downstream risk.

  • A programmatic mindset: you turn complex risk needs into operating models, requirements and roadmaps, make pragmatic trade-offs, and drive delivery.

  • Proven operational leadership of distributed teams through local leaders, with rigour in capacity planning, SLAs, QA, procedures and control evidence.

  • A track record of building or scaling automated onboarding and monitoring in a high-volume, low-touch environment.

  • Data fluency: you set meaningful KPIs, interpret rule and model performance, and work with analytics teams to improve outcomes.

  • Senior influence with Product, Commercial, Legal, Finance and executive audiences, with the confidence to challenge and find responsible ways to say yes.

  • Ability to travel to our Mauritius and Mexico offices at least twice a year.

Desirable

  • Hands-on depth in KYC/KYB, CDD and card-scheme requirements and controls.

  • Experience managing BPO or third-party operations partners, including performance governance and service-quality improvement.

  • Experience building a monitoring capability or operating model from the ground up in regulated payments or fintech.

  • Experience deploying AI-assisted operations or agentic workflows responsibly in risk, compliance or customer operations.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Locations

Overview

At GitHub, our mission is to accelerate human progress through developer collaboration. We believe people with disabilities should benefit from that progress and directly contribute to the creation of it. 

 

We are seeking a forward-thinking, determined and innovative individual, who is passionate about the intersection of accessibility and technology, to help implement our accessibility strategy, which can be found at accessibility.github.com. This role will report directly to the Head of Accessibility and will be empowered to drive change internally and externally. 

 

 The successful candidate will:

  • Have a deep understanding of accessibility, assistive technologies, and the ways that people with disabilities interact with technology.
  • Have technical expertise that is grounded in professional experience as a software developer or designer.
  • Have hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve accessibility at scale.
  • Have professional experience managing accessibility initiatives within a large matrixed organization.
  • Have a proven track record of delivering results that empower people with disabilities to use technology. 

Responsibilities

 The goals of the GitHub accessibility program are to: 

  • Empower GitHub employees to do the best work of their lives by creating an accessible work environment with internal guides and support for procurement processes.

  • Empower developers with disabilities to build on GitHub by including their input throughout the development process, cultivating a culture of accessibility within GitHub, and driving accountability at scale.

  • Empower our customers to meet their accessibility goals when building on GitHub by aggressively dogfooding the latest GitHub platform and AI features to run our internal accessibility program, Open-sourcing our internal tools when appropriate, and sharing best practices externally.

  • Help improve the accessibility of open source by empowering people with disabilities to contribute, improving the availability and adoption of open-source Assistive Technologies, and improving the accessibility of mainstream open-source projects. 

The Senior Accessibility Program Manager may contribute to all of those program goals over time. That said, their initial focus will include, but is not limited to:

  • Manage listening systems including inclusive user research and feedback processes.
  • Build an accessibility community of practice within our Enterprise customer community.
  • Grow the capabilities of the open-source GitHub accessibility scanner and accelerate adoption by customers and open-source communities. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications :

  • 7+ years experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area

    • OR equivalent experience

  • 3+ years of relevant experience driving programs or initiatives across organizational boundaries in a large organization.
  • 3+ years of experience evaluating the conformance of web content against the Web Content Accessibility guidelines.
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve accessibility at scale. 

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing accessible web-based user interfaces using JavaScript and modern web technologies.
  • Experience collecting and interpreting data for performance metrics and compliance.
  • Understanding of product road mapping and experience working with product and engineering teams to embed new features into roadmap plans. 

We encourage people with lived experience to apply.

Overview

GitHub is seeking a detail-oriented individual contributor with a technical bent and experience in technical risk management who is driven to deepen that expertise. GitHub is committed to doing right by our customers and developing a highly effective control environment where risk is managed in a meaningful and sensible way that aligns with our business. 

  • Do you love the challenge of diving into the details and learning why and how things work? 

  • Do you find yourself always asking what would have to go wrong, and how badly? 

  • Do you want to see The Big Picture, and find ways to collect and organize data to tell the story? 

  • Do you suffer from a compulsive need to document things and “get it down on paper”? 

  • And last, but most certainly not least, have you already answered the question “Why are we here?” with the GRC Truth, “Because Customers”? 

 

If so, you might be the person we are looking for! 

 

As part of GRC’s Entity Risk function, you will join the Technical Risk team and partner with engineering, security, and product subject-matter experts and leaders across GitHub to conduct capability risk assessments, develop and quantify risk scenarios, and deliver meaningful risk reporting that helps leaders make risk-informed decisions. 

Central to the team's culture is that of inclusion, transparency, and teamwork - we lift each other up to be successful! This is an excellent opportunity for an independent contributor to have a hand in elevating risk management and security as business and sales enabler as well as integrate a deeper understanding of risk management into the product and business space. 


Responsibilities

  • Lead security capability risk assessments for assigned areas, including scoping against NIST CSF subcategories, coordinating schedules and stakeholder interviews, completing maturity scoring, and publishing assessment reports. 

  • Analyze data from multiple sources to identify, analyze, and prioritize technical risks, develop and quantify FAIR-style cyber risk scenarios, evaluate capabilities against established frameworks, and assess potential impacts to GitHub – our products, services, customers, and business objectives. 

  • Partner with engineering, security, and product subject-matter experts and leaders to validate findings, identify risk patterns, and translate technical insights and stakeholder feedback into practical risk recommendations. 

  • Develop and manage risk treatment plans, drive adoption of appropriate mitigations and remediation, monitor treatment progress, and escalate unresolved or emerging risks. 

  • Maintain the risk register and supporting records in GitHub’s GRC system of record, track mitigation progress, and provide clear, recurring risk updates to technical and non-technical leaders.

    • o OR equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years experience applying security or control frameworks, such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, or ISO/IEC 27001. 

  • 5+ years experience in technical risk management, information security, audit, or compliance. 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience applying cyber risk quantification (CRQ) using FAIR or a comparable quantitative risk analysis method, including developing risk scenarios and estimating loss event frequency and loss magnitude to produce defensible loss exposure ranges that express risk in financial terms and support risk-informed investment and risk-acceptance decisions.  

  • Experience with GRC platforms used to maintain risk registers and risk treatment plans (ZenGRC, ServiceNow GRC, Archer, or comparable). 

  • Experience building risk reporting, metrics, or automation using Azure Data Explorer (Kusto/KQL), Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, Python, or comparable tools.

title: HSE and Portfolio Performance Lead
description:
About the Team

The Data Center Build and Delivery team develops the infrastructure that supports OpenAI’s research and products. We work with engineering, construction partners and Operations to deliver safe, reliable facilities at scale. As our portfolio grows, consistent health, safety and environmental practices and clear performance measures help teams identify risks early and deliver sites that are ready to operate.

About the Role

We are looking for an HSE and Portfolio Performance Lead to strengthen health, safety and environmental oversight and performance management across our data center construction portfolio. You will help sites meet applicable OSHA standards and other HSE requirements, from construction through commissioning and handoff to Operations.

You will work across site teams, delivery partners and central functions to establish practical expectations, verify execution and turn portfolio data into action. This role combines hands-on HSE expertise with a portfolio view of contractor performance, risk and operational readiness.

Key Responsibilities

Develop a consistent portfolio HSE framework covering contractor expectations, risk assessments, field verification, training and escalation, aligned with OpenAI’s EHS standards and relevant specialists.

Translate applicable OSHA construction and general-industry requirements into practical site expectations, verify implementation and clarify responsibilities as work transitions from construction to commissioning and Operations.

Partner with site and discipline leaders to assess high-risk work, verify critical controls and escalate unsafe conditions, including electrical energization, hazardous energy, lifting, excavation and concurrent construction and operating activities.

Establish portfolio performance measures and reporting for HSE outcomes, contractor performance, corrective-action closure and handoff readiness; align definitions with delivery and Operations teams and validate data quality.

Lead cross-site performance reviews to identify recurring risks, compare execution against agreed expectations and drive improvement plans with accountable owners, milestones and follow-through.

Plan risk-based site assurance and contractor reviews, support incident and near-miss investigations, verify corrective actions and embed lessons learned across the portfolio.

Coordinate environmental compliance with site teams and specialists, including waste management, spill prevention, stormwater controls and relevant permit obligations.

Define HSE readiness criteria for operational handoff with commissioning and Operations teams, including training, procedures, emergency preparedness, outstanding risks and transfer of required records.

Provide clear portfolio updates and recommendations to leadership, surface decisions and resource needs early, and build consistent safety leadership across employees, developers, contractors and service providers.

Qualifications

Substantial experience leading HSE programs for major construction or complex industrial projects, including oversight across multiple sites or workstreams and responsibility for contractor performance.

Working knowledge of applicable OSHA construction and general-industry standards, with experience translating requirements into site controls and verifying implementation across construction, commissioning and operating interfaces.

Practical understanding of data center or complex industrial hazards, including electrical safety, hazardous-energy control and high-risk construction activities.

Demonstrated ability to build assurance, performance reporting and corrective-action programs and use leading and lagging indicators to improve outcomes.

Experience coordinating contractors, site leaders and functional specialists through commissioning and operational handoff, with clear accountability across organizational boundaries.

Strong communication and judgment, with the ability to explain technical risk, influence leaders and field teams, and prioritize action in fast-changing environments.

Preferred Skills

Experience with owner-side HSE oversight across a data center or mission-critical infrastructure portfolio, including developer-led and self-build delivery models.

Experience integrating environmental compliance, emergency preparedness and HSE management systems into construction and operational readiness programs.

Relevant professional credentials, such as CSP, CIH or an equivalent safety or environmental qualification, or comparable practical expertise.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 
ABOUT THE JOB
 
The Technical Program Manager, Mathematical Software and Algorithms is responsible for overseeing the development, execution, and delivery of the Battlespace Awareness software for critical programs - ensuring it meets all technical, functional, and business requirements. Battlespace Awareness software services comprise advanced algorithms for sense-making and decision-making at tactical timelines.  This role requires an individual with a strong technical background in software development, particularly in the domain of optimization and estimation, and experience managing complex projects with multiple sub-teams and many stakeholders. The Sr Technical Program Manager will be the linchpin in ensuring that the software is developed in line with the objectives defined and is released according to the planned schedule.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Project Leadership and Strategy:
    • Develop and maintain a detailed project and execution plan - including feature development, testing and validation, deployment, and monitoring. 
    • Establish clear objectives and deliverables for the software that align with program needs.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Maintain a deep understanding of underlying algorithms and software interfaces for battle management, threat prediction, tracking, and classification to ensure that the relevant services integrate effectively with the larger C2 system.
    • Stay updated on the latest techniques to work with subject matter experts in incorporating relevant innovations into the project plan.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement:
    • Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for the project, including technical specifications, user manuals, and project reports.
    • Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Release Management:
    • Oversee the planning and execution of the software release process, ensuring that deployment is carried out smoothly and efficiently.
    • Ensure that all software releases meet the defined quality standards before deployment.
  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related communications, internally across teams and externally with stakeholders.
    • Regularly update stakeholders on project status, risks, and milestones through reports and presentations.
  • Resource Allocation:
    • Assess and allocate necessary resources, including personnel, software, and hardware, to ensure the project is adequately supported.
    • Monitor resource utilization and make adjustments as needed to avoid bottlenecks or resource constraints.
  • Risk Management:
    • Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies with the subject matter experts to minimize impact on the project timeline and deliverables.
    • Regularly review and update the risk management plan to reflect changes in the project landscape.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Work with other divisions and departments to ensure software supports the program priorities and meets all integration requirements.
    • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between the Battlespace Awareness business line and other stakeholders to promote a unified approach to program execution.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Extensive project management experience, preferably in software development.
  • Demonstrable understanding of optimization, applied probability, and AI/ML technology.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Experience with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage high-pressure situations and tight deadlines.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QAULIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity and experience working with materiel leadership or mission partners within Army Air & Missile Defense, USMC Ground Based Air Defense, SOCOM, DHS CBP, or allied defense organizations and working knowledge of the counter-UAS and air surveillance competitive landscape.
  • Experience working on or alongside a team developing mathematical software, such as optimization solvers, estimation engines, simulation frameworks, or applied probability models.

Transcripts help us assess your technical and analytical abilities, complementing our interview process in which we also evaluate practical experience and cultural fit. If you choose not to share your transcripts, you will need to provide detailed information regarding your academic performance in relevant courses, including projects and coursework specifics, to ensure we evaluate your academic accomplishments properly. If you do provide academic transcripts, feel free to redact non-technical information (e.g., student ID, dates, non-technical coursework, etc.). Unofficial transcripts obtained online acceptable for this assessment.

title: Senior Manager Energy Strategy & Portfolio Development (m/w/d)
description:
Über EUPD Research Sustainable Management GmbH

Seit dem Jahr 2000 entwickelt die EUPD Research Sustainable Management GmbH innovative und ganzheitliche Lösungen für Nachhaltigkeitsmärkte. Auf Basis von Primärdaten, Analysen, Zertifizierungen und Publikationen strukturiert und multipliziert das Team erfolgreiche Geschäftsstrategien in den Bereichen Photovoltaik, Energiespeicher, Wärmepumpen, Elektromobilität, ESG sowie Corporate Health.

Gestalte die Weiterentwicklung unseres Energy-Geschäfts – strategisch, datenbasiert und mit klarem Blick auf Portfolio, Markt und Umsetzung.

Du möchtest nicht nur einzelne Projekte begleiten, sondern mitgestalten, welche Themen, Produkte und Geschäftsfelder im Bereich erneuerbare Energien künftig relevant werden? Du kannst Markt-, Technologie- und Kundenentwicklungen einordnen, Prioritäten ableiten und unterschiedliche Fachperspektiven zu belastbaren Entscheidungen zusammenführen?

Dann werde Teil der EUPD Group und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns die nächste Entwicklungsphase unseres Energy-Portfolios.

Als Senior Manager Energy Strategy & Portfolio Development (m/w/d) verbindest Du Markt- und Technologieintelligenz, Research, Produktentwicklung und kommerzielle Anforderungen zu einem konsistenten Gesamtbild. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den jeweiligen Fachverantwortlichen unser Portfolio weiter, bereitest strategische Entscheidungen vor und sorgst dafür, dass neue Ideen in realistische, wirtschaftlich tragfähige Angebote und Prioritäten übersetzt werden.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Management die strategische Ausrichtung und das Portfolio des Energy-Bereichs weiter und übersetzt Markt-, Technologie- und Kundenentwicklungen in klare Prioritäten und Handlungsfelder.

• Du steuerst die Weiterentwicklung unseres Studien-, Daten-, Analyse-, Zertifizierungs- und Advisory-Portfolios und bewertest bestehende sowie neue Angebote hinsichtlich Marktbedarf, strategischem Fit, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Skalierungspotenzial.

• Du entwickelst neue daten- und researchbasierte Produkte und Beratungsansätze von der ersten Idee über Value Proposition und Business Case bis zur Pilotierung und strukturierten Übergabe in die operative Umsetzung.

• Du integrierst Inputs aus Market Intelligence, Technology & Product Intelligence, Research und Sales in belastbare Portfolio- und Managemententscheidungen.

• Du bereitest Priorisierungs-, Investitions-, Ressourcen- und Stop/Start-Entscheidungen datenbasiert vor und machst Auswirkungen auf Kapazität und Wirtschaftlichkeit transparent.

title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
description:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

Physical Intelligence is bringing general-purpose AI into the physical world. We are a group of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders developing foundation models and learning algorithms to power the robots of today and the physically-actuated devices of the future.

5+ years of experience in program management, operations, technical project management, consulting, startup operations, or similar roles

Strong problem solving and systems thinking; ability to identify points of leverage in a constantly-evolving system and diagnose problems with incomplete information

Intuition for data quality and research needs, grounded in understanding of model training and evaluation

Stellar communication and ability to clarify nuance, structure complex information in digestible ways, and work with remote, ESL audiences

Organizational skills to bring structure to chaos and balance needs across multiple programs

Bonus points

Experience with data annotations for ML/AI, having seen versions of this problem before

Experience with robotics, egocentric video, or other multimodal sensor data

Experience with using coding agents to fill gaps in tooling / infra

title: Technical project and program manager
description:
Company Overview
KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

Group/Division
With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The RAPID division is the world leading provider of reticle inspection solutions for the semiconductor industry. The company provides inspection solutions to both the mask shops and the semiconductor fabs to ensure that lithography yields are consistently high thus enabling cost-effective manufacturing.

Job Description/Preferred Qualifications

Responsibility and Scope  

Lead engineering development projects for mask inspection products in RAPID division of KLA  

Assess, evaluate risks, and drive projects forward with an eye for critical path  

Communicate cross-functionally with a diverse team including engineering, marketing, manufacturing, and service to drive execution  

Lead, encourage, empower, and influence team members to achieve excellence in engineering rigor, reliability, usability, and customer focus  

Articulate and present execution plans for internal leadership as well as external customers  

Identify bottlenecks and remove obstacles for the team to focus on value-add activities  

Hold regular meetings between functional groups to ensure interdependencies are well understood and documented  

Support roadmap development by detailing upcoming requirement changes and resources required  

You will be a phenomenal fit for our team if you like:  

To work with pioneering technology with meaningful impact on semiconductor industry   

To work with passionate people with a diverse set of backgrounds  

To build positive relationships, and develop new skills in a high-tech environment  

To take on sophisticated and ambitious projects and succeed in the marketplace  

 

Preferred Qualifications & Attributes   

Master or advanced degree in Engineering or Physical Sciences  

6+ years of industry experience in Engineering and/or Project Management of multidisciplinary products  

Great teammate with strong leadership, critical thinking, communication and analytical skills  

Curiosity and disposition towards learning fast beyond immediate knowledge span  

Track record for leading teams through influence rather than direct reporting line  

Experience in Capital Equipment sectors is a plus (e.g. Semiconductors, Medical Equipment, Robotics)  

Experience with Project Management tools (MS Project, Wrike, Jira, etc)  

PMP or Agile certification is a plus  

Minimum Qualifications

Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 6 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 8 years

Base Pay Range: $159,500.00 - $271,200.00 Annually

Primary Location: USA-CA-Milpitas-KLA

KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave.

Interns are eligible for some of the benefits listed. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Actual pay depends on several factors, including state minimum pay wage rates, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education level or training. We are committed to complying with all applicable federal and state minimum wage requirements where applicable. If applicable, your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. title: Engineering Technician III – Senior CNC Programmer – 5-Axis Milling
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.
 

SUMMARY

This role develops, launches and sustains complex CNC milling processes, independently delivering safe, capable, compliant and cost-effective solutions.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Independently owns complete multi-axis milling solutions from manufacturability review through CAD/CAM programming, post processing, machine setup, prove-out, FAI, validation, release and production.

Programs and optimizes complex 3-, 4- and 5-axis milling processes using advanced G/M code, Macro B and Siemens and/or Fanuc control language; diagnoses complete process and machine issues.

Leads CNC activities for new-product and process improvements; Delivers on schedule, quality, capacity and cost targets with minimal intervention or rework.

Provides expert hands-on troubleshooting and failure analysis for CNC mills and related automation, probing, laser tool-setting and multi-axis systems.

Develops and implements cutting-tool, holder and fixture strategies; demonstrates advanced tool/fixture design capability and collaborates effectively with designers, suppliers and equipment builders.

Drives equipment requirements, machine selection, vendor acceptance, installation, alignment and qualification; independently interfaces with vendors and contributes technical recommendations to site and customer manufacturing discussions.

Establishes and shares CAD/CAM and machining best practices, delivers meaningful cost and productivity improvements, and formally mentors lower-level technicians, programmers and operators.

Partners across Engineering, Operations and Maintenance; prioritize multiple assignments, communicates technical decisions and completes projects on time and with high quality.

Acts as a role model for Machine Operators in terms of attitude, machine asset care, troubleshooting, adherence to processes and decision making.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

Associate’s degree or equivalent technical certification preferred; equivalent combination of education and experience considered.

4+ years of advanced CNC programming required, including significate experience with 5-axis milling.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS REQUIREMENTS

Subject-matter-expert-level ability to take complex 5-axis surface milled components from concept through stable production using 5-axis milling best practices.

Experience deploying processes with machine probing, parametric programming, and machine calculations.

Advanced CAD/CAM proficiency, including 3D model preparation, geometry repair, fixture modeling, and toolpath generation.

Advanced Mastercam programming and multi-axis toolpath development required.

Proficiency with Fanuc ISO G/M and/or Siemens programming languages.

Proficiency with interpreting technical drawings and GD&T.

CMM data interpretation, use of complex manual gaging.

Expert troubleshooting, mentoring, technical leadership, and cross-functional collaboration.

Working knowledge of Macro B programming preferred.

Proficiency with Fanuc Robodrill and/or DMG DMP70 machining platforms preferred.

Experience integrating CNC equipment with automation systems, robotic loading, pallet systems, and machine-to-machine communication preferred.

description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world. 

What We Offer

Salary:
$133,500.00 - $183,500.00

Location:
Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

The JOLT Program Management Office & Operations Product Development team drives technology, business processes, and strategic innovation supporting Applied Materials Global Operations. The rapid growth in semiconductor markets across the world presents unprecedented challenges and opportunities in manufacturing, supply chain and logistics. In this role, you will support programs that serve as key enablers for Global Operations. We need individuals who are thoughtful, eager to learn, and ready to change how an entire industry approaches solving problems.

Responsibilities

Program Execution & Stakeholder Coordination

Support end-to-end execution of Integrated Business Planning (IBP) initiatives, ensuring milestones, dependencies, and actions are clearly tracked.

Bring structure and clarity to ambiguous problem spaces by defining work plans, timelines, and success criteria.

Coordinate with cross-functional partners across Supply Chain, SPG, JOLT, and Business Units to gather inputs, align priorities, and close gaps.

Ensure planning assumptions, risks, and opportunities are clearly documented.

Partner with Supply Planning, Demand Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Product Management, and Business Units.

Proactively identify risks, data gaps, and execution issues; escalate with clear context and recommended actions.

Prepare program status updates, meeting notes, and follow-ups to ensure accountability and momentum.

Produce executive-ready updates, decision documents, and business cases — tables, charts, and slides that a leader can act on without a verbal briefing.

Drive alignment between stakeholders with competing priorities and unclear decision rights and make the decision path explicit when it isn't.

Operate effectively without formal authority across matrixed, geographically distributed teams.

Data Analysis & Decision Support

Perform detailed analysis across supply, demand, capacity, and material data to support planning decisions.

Analyze outputs from planning and analytics tools (e.g., reports, heat maps, scenario outputs) to identify trends, constraints, and inconsistencies.

Build and maintain analytical models, trackers, and summaries using Excel to support ongoing planning programs.

Translate data into clear, structured insights and executive-ready summaries (tables, charts, and slides).

Qualifications

Analytical & Technical Skills

Strong analytical skills with advanced Excel proficiency, including complex formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data validation, and scenario/sensitivity analysis.

Ability to structure, clean, and analyze large and imperfect datasets.

Working understanding of SQL and relational database concepts (tables, joins, keys) to query and interpret data.

Experience creating clear data visualizations and summaries for business decision-making.

Professional Experience & Attributes

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Operations, Business, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, or related field.

8–12 years in technical program management, business operations, or operations transformation, including at least 3 years leading programs with both business and technical stakeholders.

Advanced Excel: complex formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data validation, and scenario/sensitivity analysis. Working SQL and relational database fluency (tables, joins, keys) sufficient to query and interpret operational data independently.

Ability to structure, clean, and analyze large and imperfect datasets, and to turn the result into an executive-ready recommendation.

Ability to structure ambiguous problems, develop execution plans, and drive teams toward measurable outcomes.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-facing presentation and facilitation capabilities.

Strong ownership mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

Experience in semiconductor, manufacturing, engineering, operations, supply chain, product development, or technology environments.

Experience leading business transformation, operational excellence, enterprise systems, data/analytics, automation, or digital product programs.

Direct experience in semiconductor or high-mix manufacturing planning — supply planning, capacity planning, or materials management.

Experience with S&OP process management, clear understanding all aspect of S&OP / IBP

Experience with an enterprise planning system (SAP APO/IBP, Kinaxis, o9, or comparable).

Track record delivering in both Agile and stage-gate environments and choosing correctly between them.

Additional Information

Full time

Assignee / Regular

Yes, 10% of the Time

Yes
